content:
A UFO whistleblower claims U.S. troops have done battle with deadly “reptilian” alien giants and that the American government is concealing a massive underwater extraterrestrial base.

The whistleblower, David Grusch, is a veteran of the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) and the National Reconnaissance Office (NRO). Prior to entering the intelligence field, he served 14 years in the Air Force. He and a number of other former U.S. government officials have been outspoken about the presence of aliens on Earth.

Grusch made these latest claims during a recent appearance on The Joe Rogan Experience, describing the aliens as having scaly skin and gorilla-like bodies, more than seven feet tall.

He claimed that after these “reptilian” alien giants survived the crash of a tic-tac-shaped craft, U.S. military soldiers shot and killed them because “they posed a threat.” Additionally, he claimed that U.S. servicemen were killed and injured during the conflict, while admitting that he was unsure of the precise number of casualties.

David Grusch also claimed that the “reptilian” aliens were found at these locations alongside dead “gray” aliens because they were engaged in combat with one another.

Additionally, Grusch said he has seen clear video of dead aliens collected from a crash site. He described them as having pale, bluish-white skin and resembling humans. He said the footage showed a retrieval operation.

David Grusch also says the U.S. government is aware of a gigantic underwater alien base

According to Grusch, senior U.S. government officials are aware of at least one massive underwater base that serves as an alien spacecraft launchpad.

“There’s clearly some sort of base of operations in certain locations. It’s large. Don’t know when it got there… Like multiple city blocks type stuff,” he said.

He went on to say that “stuff comes and goes” from the massive subterranean hub and that his information came from insider admissions, top-secret files, and classified footage, but he was unable to provide specifics because they involve “sensitive Navy underwater things.”

Last September, Tennessee Congressman Tim Burchett claimed for at least the second time that the United States government has knowledge about underwater alien bases. As part of his claims, Burchett said there are “entities” located at five or six deep-water sites on Earth.

When Joe Rogan asked if any of this footage would ever be made available to the public, David Grusch replied, “Probably. There’s a lot of audio-visual stuff.”

“The problem with the current climate is you’re going to have to wheel out the physical evidence, too, because the trust in government is so low right now,” he claimed.

David Grusch has been making shocking alien and UFO claims for several years

Back in June, David Grusch, Congresspersons Anna Paulina Luna, Burchett, Eric Burlison, and Jared Moskowitz held a press conference on the lawn by the U.S. Capitol.

“There are serious homeland security and airspace safety issues,” said Grusch, who testified before Congress in 2023. “For decades, unknown objects have freely operated in restricted airspace, in large metropolitan areas and critical infrastructure, and the agencies responsible for securing the homeland cannot adequately defend against it. This is a serious national security issue.”

In 2024, Grusch testified before the House Oversight Committee about the existence of secret black programs inside the United States government. These program, he claims, conducted unsanctioned technological research related to UFOs.

He has also claimed to know of a spacecraft in the U.S. government’s possession. Grusch said he shared this information with the FBI, CIA, Department of Homeland Security, tech entrepreneurs, and financial leaders during a secret meeting in New York City.
